m002.cr306__custom__help: Enter a JSON object from your provider’s documentation. These parameters are sent with requests for this model.
m002.cr306__custom__empty: Use {'{}'} to send no custom parameters. Blank text is not {'{}'} and cannot be saved.
m002.cr306__custom__protected: Credentials, model, messages, streaming, URLs, and headers cannot be set here. Use the existing fields above for output tokens and structured output.
m002.cr306__custom__rules: JSON objects only; maximum 16 KiB and 8 levels. Duplicate keys and U+0000 characters are rejected.
m002.cr306__error__invalid_json: The JSON is incomplete. Check brackets, quotes, and commas. Your input is preserved.
m002.cr306__error__duplicate_key: An object cannot contain duplicate keys. Remove the duplicate and try again. Your input is preserved.
m002.cr306__error__object_required: Enter a JSON object such as {'{}'}. Arrays, null, and other values cannot be saved.
m002.cr306__error__protected_field: This field is protected or already has a dedicated setting. Remove it from custom parameters. Your input is preserved.
m002.cr306__error__too_deep: The JSON exceeds 8 levels of nesting. Simplify it and try again. Your input is preserved.
m002.cr306__error__number_out_of_range: A number is outside the safe range. Adjust it using the provider documentation. Your input is preserved.
m002.cr306__error__unsupported_character: A parameter contains the unsupported U+0000 character. Remove it and try again. Your input is preserved.
m002.cr306__error__request_too_large: The complete save request exceeds the request-size limit. Reduce the configuration and try again; all edits are preserved.
m002.cr306__conflict__body: Refresh to merge the remote version while keeping the parameters you are editing. Review them before saving again.
m002.cr306__probe__ok: The short connection test passed. It confirms a streamed response only; it does not prove full generation, parameter behavior, or structured output.
m002.cr306__probe__rejected: The provider rejected this short connection test. Nothing was saved; check the platform parameters and the fixed 256-token output limit before trying again.
m002.cr306__probe__stale: The configuration changed, so the previous test result is no longer current. You can still save directly; test again only when you need to verify the connection.
m002.cr306__save__no-call: Saving updates configuration without calling the model. Run a connection test separately.
m002.cr306__saved__body: The model configuration was updated. Previous connection test results are no longer current; test again when needed.
m002.cr306__discard__body: Closing discards this form’s changes. Choose Keep editing to preserve the custom JSON and other input.

m002.m003__content__scope: Paid plans: check target-word use, logic, and content; 1–99 sets the maximum conditional rewrites.
m002.m003__preview__fixturematch: The demo input changed. Choose the words and meaning language used by this sample before previewing.
m002.cr306__error__too_large: Custom parameters exceed {limit}. Reduce them and try again; your input is preserved.
m002.welcome: Welcome back, {name}. It has been {elapsed} since your last session.
m002.models__desc: Manage providers, connections, and available models.
m002.plans__desc: Configure allowances, model access, and content service for fixed plans.
m002.checkin__effect: Check-in changes take effect on the target environment’s next learning day.
m002.portability__completeScope: Exports the complete category, regardless of current filters or pagination.
m002.export__keyless: A standard export does not contain API keys. It can be reviewed and retained, but cannot complete a model replacement import.
m002.export__includeKeysHelp: Select only when moving model configuration. Store the file and password separately.
m002.export__passwordHelp: Use 12–128 Unicode scalar values and no more than 512 UTF-8 bytes. The password cannot be all whitespace or contain U+0000. It is used exactly as entered, without trimming or Unicode normalization, and cannot be recovered.
m002.export__passwordMismatch: The file passwords do not match.
m002.export__ready: The design demo prepared a download result. No real file or encryption was performed.
m002.import__scopeWarning: After validation, this file replaces the category’s complete active configuration. Existing entries omitted from the file leave the active configuration.
m002.import__noWrite: Choosing, decrypting, and previewing do not change the current configuration.
m002.import__passwordHelp: Enter the original export password. It must contain 12–128 Unicode scalar values, use no more than 512 UTF-8 bytes, and cannot be all whitespace or contain U+0000. It is not trimmed or Unicode-normalized. Passwords and keys are not shown in the interface, errors, or logs.
m002.import__reading: Reading and validating the complete configuration…
m002.preview__valid: File and field validation passed. Target configuration and dependencies will be checked again on submission.
m002.preview__modelsEffect: Removed models are no longer available for new generations. Existing stories and run history remain. Provider connections are not tested.
m002.preview__plansEffect: All four fixed plans are replaced. Used allowance, trial expiry, and users’ base plans stay unchanged. In-flight requests keep their accepted snapshot.
m002.preview__itemsEffect: Active item definitions are replaced. Inventory, issuance, and usage history remain.
m002.preview__growthEffect: The latest complete check-in rules from the file take effect on the target’s next learning day. Personal growth, attainment, and claim history remain.
m002.preview__credentials: Encrypted credentials from this file are present for all {count} connections
m002.preview__notProviderVerified: Successful decryption and local format checks do not mean providers accept these keys. Import does not test connections.
m002.confirm__ack: I reviewed removals and effects and confirm that only this category will be replaced.
m002.submit__pending: Rechecking and replacing the complete category…
m002.submit__pendingHelp: Submission has been sent. Closing the page cannot cancel it; wait for a definitive result.
m002.result__successHelp: Only the selected category was replaced. Runtime history and other categories were unchanged.
m002.result__unknownHelp: The connection ended after submission, so the outcome is unknown. Check the result or read current configuration before submitting again.
m002.error__category: The file category is {fileCategory}, but the current category is {currentCategory}.
m002.error__missingKey: {category} › {item} › API key: no decryptable key is present. Export a new complete package with encrypted keys from the source environment.
m002.error__wrongPassword: The file could not be decrypted. Check the file password or confirm the file is not damaged.
m002.error__dependencyHelp: Current configuration is unchanged. Resolve dependencies in the referenced categories, then choose the file and preview again.
m002.error__itemDependency: Issuance history or reward references block item replacement
m002.error__stale: Target configuration changed; the preview is no longer valid
m002.error__staleHelp: Another administrator changed the configuration or a related dependency. Read and preview again; the previous confirmation cannot be used.
m002.field__help: These are operational field rules, not file or API field names. See the product field table for the complete rules.
m002.field__modelRequired: Protocol, base URL, a key for every connection, model ID, output mode, enabled state, and custom parameters object
m002.field__modelOptional: Connection/model names and descriptions, and maximum output tokens; omission generates or clears values as specified and never inherits target values
m002.field__zero: false, 0, null, an empty array, and a missing field are different inputs. Required values are not filled from admin defaults.
m002.demo__help: Switches deterministic design states only. It does not read files, encrypt data, or write configuration.
m002.prototype__title: See the impact before replacing a category
m002.prototype__desc: This prototype validates credential export, file validation, category replacement preview, confirmation, and outcome recovery. The formal design separately shows exact placement in the current admin UI.
m002.growth__rulesScopeHelp: Includes check-in, levels, and all four achievement types, regardless of the current tab.
m002.items__scopeHelp: Includes active item definitions only, without inventory, issuance, or usage history.
m002.changes__help: Use safe identities to locate additions, updates, and removals. Expand a group to review business fields and the applied results of omitted fields.
m002.changes__confirmHelp: Removals are expanded. Confirmation replaces only this category; listed historical data remains.
m002.growth__effective: Check-in rules take effect in the target environment on {date} (Beijing time); today and historical check-ins keep their original rules.
m002.import__fileLimit: A configuration file can be up to 8 MiB. Choosing, decrypting, and previewing do not change the current configuration.
m002.export__passwordInvalid: The password does not meet the file-protection requirements. Check its length, UTF-8 byte count, whitespace, and U+0000.
m002.import__passwordInvalid: The password format is invalid. Use the original export password.
m002.result__notAppliedHelp: The server confirmed that this operation did not replace any configuration. Current configuration is unchanged. To try again, choose the file, preview, and confirm again.
m002.result__expiredHelp: It is no longer possible to confirm whether this operation was applied. Reading current configuration shows only the current state and does not prove this operation’s result. Do not resubmit the old operation based on that snapshot.
m002.result__tokenInvalid: This recovery token cannot be verified
m002.result__tokenInvalidHelp: It is not possible to confirm whether this operation was applied. Reading current configuration shows only the current state and does not prove this operation’s result. A new import must start with a new file selection, preview, and confirmation.
m002.result__superseded: This import succeeded, but the current configuration was changed afterward. The success summary belongs to this operation; the refreshed host page shows the latest configuration.
m002.result__refreshFailed: This import succeeded, but the host page could not load the latest configuration. Read the page configuration again; do not repeat the import.
m002.confirm__previewExpired: The submission deadline has passed and the previous confirmation is no longer valid. Choose the file and preview again.
m002.notice__nameGenerated: The name was generated using the defined rule.
m002.notice__optionalValueCleared: The omitted optional value was cleared and does not inherit the old target value.
m002.notice__rewardQuantityZero: No reward item is selected, so the reward quantity is applied as 0.
m002.notice__checkinCurrentSelected: The source file has no pending check-in rules, so the complete current rules will be used for the target environment’s next learning day.
m002.notice__languageFallback: This language value is empty. The interface falls back to the other language without generating or saving a translation.
m002.notice__planNoModels: This plan explicitly has no available models.
m002.notice__planNoLengths: This plan explicitly has no available lengths.
m002.notice__categoryCleared: This file clears the active configuration for this category. Submission still depends on the blocker checks.
m002.notice__effectivePlanMayChange: Some users’ effective plans may change. Runtime history and accepted in-flight work keep their original snapshots.
m002.notice__levelMayDowngrade: Some users’ current levels may decrease; achievement and claim history is preserved.
m002.notice__unknown: This item has an additional configuration notice. Review the complete preview.
m002.error__reason__objectRequired: This field must be an object.
m002.error__reason__outOfRange: The value is outside the allowed range.
m002.error__reason__immutableField: This field cannot be changed by import.
m002.error__reason__invalidReference: The referenced configuration does not exist or is unavailable.
m002.error__reason__protectedField: This field is not allowed in the configuration file.
m002.error__reason__unsupportedCharacter: The value contains an unsupported character.
m002.confirm__deadline: Submit by {deadline}, 5 minutes after the preview was created. After that, preview again. This result can be checked until {retainUntil}.
m002.result__lookupWindow: This result can be checked until {retainUntil}, 24 hours after the submission deadline.
m002.result__currentHelp: Read at {readAt}. This snapshot shows only the current {category} configuration and does not prove whether the earlier operation was applied.
m002.pron__gesture: Your browser needs another click before it can play audio.
m002.pron__unavailable: This word’s pronunciation is temporarily unavailable.
m002.pron__accentUnavailable: The selected pronunciation for {word} ({accent}) is unavailable. Choose an available alternative.
